The work behind the words

Profile

I work where language, editorial judgment and audience behaviour meet. At Red FM Malayalam, I shape digital content strategy, editorial calendars, video scripts, interview frameworks, branded campaigns and post-production narratives — while keeping the voice human, sharp and culturally rooted.

Across my Red FM career, I have worked with and coordinated digital content and campaigns across five Red FM stations in Kerala. That cross-station experience has meant adapting ideas to different audiences, teams and local contexts while keeping the larger brand voice consistent.

My editorial practice also comes from print and literature: I have edited published books, worked with a fiction-focused literary magazine, written for established Malayalam publications and led a student editorial board.

Across every format, the goal stays the same: find the clearest, most compelling way to tell the story.

“The format changes. The editorial instinct doesn't.”Malayalam · English · Print · Broadcast · Digital

Campaign · Concept to execution · 5-station coordination
Onam Campaign, 2025

Concept, Design & Execution. Developed the campaign concepts, wrote and designed the posters, and shared reel concepts with RJs. Managed the campaign end-to-end through social media, coordinating content across all five Red FM stations in Kerala. The campaign combined festive storytelling, station-specific ideas and interactive social formats into one cohesive Onam presence.

Interview series · Editorial scripting
Music Lounge, with Nithya Mammen

For Music Lounge with Nithya Mammen, I handled the editorial scripting behind the show. This involved researching the guest, preparing the question set and shaping a conversation arc that gave the host a strong structure without making the interaction feel rehearsed. I built questions around the musician's journey, influences, creative process, career milestones, collaborations, memorable songs and the person behind the public persona. I also thought through transitions and follow-up possibilities so the host could move naturally from one layer of the conversation to the next. The series featured conversations with some of Kerala's leading musicians and playback singers.

Short-form storytelling · National sales
Reels scripted for national sales projects

Scripted reels for multiple national sales projects, translating campaign briefs into concise, audience-friendly stories for social platforms. The role involved finding the central idea, writing the spoken narrative and shaping the copy so the commercial message could land naturally within a short-form format — while keeping the content conversational, visually clear and aligned with the campaign objective.

Voice-over scripting · High-reach digital content
Voice-overs that travelled to millions

Scripted a huge volume of Malayalam voice-overs for Red FM Malayalam's digital videos, covering entertainment, pop culture, timely stories and social-first formats. The writing had to be immediate, conversational and visually led — giving the edit a clear narrative while keeping the audience engaged. Several of these videos went on to reach millions of views across digital platforms. The thumbnails below represent the breadth of this high-volume scripting work.

Vodcast · South Side Story
Malayalam vodcast question scripting

Scripted questions and conversation frameworks for Malayalam vodcasts under South Side Story. The work focused on research-led question design: building prompts that could unlock a guest's story, move beyond predictable talking points and still feel natural for a digital audience. The framework gave the host enough structure to guide the conversation while leaving room for spontaneous answers, anecdotes and follow-ups.
